tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List the tools of this server with prices, data sources, licensing, daily limits and data freshness.

tools.name: jp_customs_fx
tools.description: Which JPY rate did Japan Customs publish for this currency on this date? Input: ISO 4217 code and YYYY-MM-DD date. Returns status (valid/invalid/unknown), the inclusive effective period, the JPY rate as published with its base units (1 or 100), source URLs, retrieval and verification times and SHA-2

tools.name: jp_fsa_registry_lookup
tools.description: Is this business (name, registration or 13-digit corporate number) on a Japan FSA register or warning list? Exact match (optional domain) against: registered financial instruments, crypto-asset exchange, electronic payment instruments, funds transfer and money lending businesses, and FSA warnings to

tools.name: fsa_register_changes
tools.description: Which entries were added to, dropped from, changed in or returned to Japan FSA registers and warning lists since a date? From this service's own record of list versions (the FSA publishes only current lists). Each change has the list, registration number, name as published (personal names withheld),

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.

tools.name: jp_customs_fx_batch
tools.description: Which JPY rates did Japan Customs publish for these 1-50 currency/date pairs? One call returns ordered per-item status, effective periods, JPY rates as published with base units (1 or 100), source URLs, retrieval and verification times and hashes, read from one dataset snapshot. Dates from 2021-08-1

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jp_customs_fx_batch · Private data: fsa_register_changes · Public sink: jp_customs_fx, jp_customs_fx_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jp_customs_fx_batch · Private data: fsa_register_changes · Public sink: jp_customs_fx, jp_customs_fx_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
